word.definition: Balmy is an adjective that is often used to describe weather that is warm, calm, and pleasant. It can also be used to describe someone or something (such as an idea) that is foolish or irrational.

quote.text: The weather is so very mild, That some would call it warm. Good gracious, aren't we lucky, child? Here comes a thunderstorm.
quote.author: Ogden Nash
